tests.requirement: A built package imports without ML frameworks, CUDA, Docker, or model credentials.
tests.verification: Install wheel in a clean external environment and import the core package.

tests.requirement: Two synthetic project repositories are generated outside the framework source root.
tests.verification: Check canonical paths; no user repository locator is consulted.

tests.requirement: The offline demo executes real fixture commands and produces verified artifacts.
tests.verification: Block network after setup and compare outputs to independently calculable values.

tests.requirement: A deterministic mock agent tests orchestration without model calls.
tests.verification: Assert provider call count is zero and replay yields expected task proposals.

tests.requirement: Registration does not execute hooks, imports, installation, or project code.
tests.verification: Register a fixture with a trap setup/hook and assert the sentinel is untouched.

tests.requirement: Runtime/lab/project data do not reside inside the framework checkout.
tests.verification: Reject conflicting canonical roots including symlink aliases.

tests.requirement: Candidates modifying the same relative file remain independent.
tests.verification: Change candidate A; verify B, baseline and original external project hashes are unchanged.

tests.requirement: Dirty sources are rejected or explicitly snapshotted with complete identity.
tests.verification: Exercise tracked and untracked changes; no silent omission.

tests.requirement: Behavior changes alter recipe identity; presentation-only changes do not.
tests.verification: Property-test canonicalization, floats, key ordering and semantic-field coverage.

tests.requirement: Malformed/oversized/mismatched adapter responses fail without publication.
tests.verification: Inject unknown major version, missing artifact and wrong attempt ID.

tests.requirement: Safe artifact ingestion rejects traversal, symlinks and incomplete files.
tests.verification: Use synthetic malicious paths and partial output markers.

tests.requirement: Worker cannot access controller state/policy or another candidate.
tests.verification: Perform actual forbidden reads/writes with non-sensitive sentinels.

tests.requirement: No host home, drive, SSH agent or container socket is exposed to workers.
tests.verification: Inspect mounts and attempt accesses from inside the worker.

tests.requirement: Denied network access fails, including subprocess attempts.
tests.verification: Use a local test egress endpoint; assert no request arrives.

tests.requirement: CPU/RAM/PID/time and applicable storage caps have explicit tested enforcement.
tests.verification: Exceed each declared cap safely; reject contracts requiring unsupported hard caps.

tests.requirement: Campaign budgets include retries and cannot be reset by creating new task IDs.
tests.verification: Exhaust a small budget across failed attempts and deny the next launch.

tests.requirement: Cancellation stops the complete job before resources are released.
tests.verification: Spawn child processes and verify all are stopped after cancellation.

tests.requirement: An unavailable requested security profile fails closed.
tests.verification: Remove a backend capability and ensure no subprocess fallback runs.

tests.requirement: Approvals bind to contract digest, policy version, principal and expiry.
tests.verification: Replay an approval against modified inputs or worker identity and deny it.

tests.requirement: Candidate/evaluator separation protects final targets.
tests.verification: Use sentinel target data unavailable to prediction workers and verify no access.

tests.requirement: Tampered evaluators cannot certify a candidate.
tests.verification: Modify candidate-local evaluator code and require independent registered identity.

tests.requirement: A fabricated metric is rejected by independent computation.
tests.verification: Submit a favorable score with worse predictions and certify only the recomputed result.

tests.requirement: An honest negative finding completes the campaign successfully.
tests.verification: Use a known inferior treatment and ensure there is no retry-until-win loop.

tests.requirement: A known analytic oracle or counterexample defeats a plausible wrong implementation.
tests.verification: Keep reference logic separate from candidate logic and mutation-test the check.

tests.requirement: Every evaluated trial and selection choice remains in history.
tests.verification: Include failed, abandoned and unfavorable trials in the campaign ledger.

tests.requirement: Changing a frozen metric or selection rule requires a new contract version.
tests.verification: Attempt mutation during confirmation and block or create an explicit amendment.

tests.requirement: Reports distinguish execution, validity, finding and assurance.
tests.verification: Reject a report that equates exit-zero with a supported scientific claim.

tests.requirement: Provider adapters share one typed task/result boundary.
tests.verification: Run mock, captured Codex and captured Claude responses through conformance tests.

tests.requirement: Provider failures are bounded, recorded and do not mutate authority.
tests.verification: Simulate quota, malformed JSON, timeout, refusal and duplicate events.

tests.requirement: A live provider task is actually tested under an approved budget.
tests.verification: Record installed versions, requests, outputs, usage and sanitized evidence; no credentials means blocked.

tests.requirement: Provider credential boundary survives arbitrary project subprocesses.
tests.verification: Use synthetic token sentinels and verify they cannot be read by untrusted code.

tests.requirement: Crash recovery does not blindly duplicate an existing job.
tests.verification: Crash before/after dispatch persistence and reconcile by stable backend identity.

tests.requirement: Lease expiry does not free an occupied resource without reconciliation.
tests.verification: Keep old job alive, expire heartbeat, and deny conflicting replacement.

tests.requirement: State-machine transitions preserve terminal history and reservations.
tests.verification: Generate action sequences with Hypothesis and compare to a reference model.

tests.requirement: Cache reuse is not counted as an independent replicate.
tests.verification: Reuse an artifact then request replication; check evidence and randomization identities.

tests.requirement: Evaluator/data invalidation reaches dependent claims.
tests.verification: Invalidate a parent artifact and assert reports become stale/invalid without deleting history.

tests.requirement: Backup/restore and retention preserve documented evidence status.
tests.verification: Restore an interrupted campaign; GC cannot silently remove required evidence.

tests.requirement: Blocked work does not prevent independent authorized progress.
tests.verification: Block a critical input for one branch; execute another ready task without expanding permissions.

tests.requirement: Evidence export/import verifies hashes and preserves trust labels.
tests.verification: Round-trip a bundle, alter one artifact, reject tampering; imported evidence is not self-certified.

tests.requirement: An unsupported numeric claim cannot appear as certified evidence.
tests.verification: Inject invented report numbers and require links to computed fields.

tests.requirement: Clean-install demo needs no active research repository.
tests.verification: Run the built wheel outside the checkout using only generated fixtures.

tests.requirement: Platform and feature gate reporting is honest.
tests.verification: Show blocked isolation/live/GPU checks separately from passed core checks.

tests.requirement: GPU capability and exclusive Kestrel scheduling are tested on actual hardware.
tests.verification: Probe driver/container and run bounded jobs; report unmanaged-host contention limitation.

tests.requirement: A source edit cannot authorize self-deployment of the controller.
tests.verification: Submit a worker request to upgrade policy/runtime and deny it without operator authority.

tests.requirement: Project memory retrieval respects source permissions and data classifications.
tests.verification: Deny cross-project retrieval of restricted synthetic records and record the decision.

tests.requirement: All required acceptance checks have concrete evidence, not unchecked declarations.
tests.verification: Generate release-gate report from actual results and identify missing/blocked checks.
